body.statement: For every \((G,P)\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PNHZ}}\), consider a measured endpoint pair \((D_\ell(A),D_\ell(B))\in\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\) issued by a complete RankPeel run as a singleton, pair, baseline-neutrality, or augmented-neutrality query. If a latent set \(Z\subseteq V\setminus V_0\) \(d\)-separates those endpoints in \(G\), then \(R^{\mathrm{law}}_{P_X}(D_\ell(A),D_\ell(B))\le\min\{|D_\ell(A)|,|D_\ell(B)|,|Z|\}\).
body.justification: This is the query-specific one-way analytic implication for the law-invariant oracle and avoids a blanket rank-equals-minimum-separator identity.
body.gap: The published argument does not establish representative stability or justify its differentiation step under Conditions 1--3 exactly as stated.
body.consumer: Every upper half of a version-stable parentless, pure-block, or neutrality decision uses this bound.
